shellCommands.command: ls /workspace && echo "---" && cat /workspace/package.json && echo "---DOCS---" && ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null
grep -rl -i "view.transition\|viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -50
find app lib __agent_eval__ -type f | head -60 && echo "---CONFIG---" && cat next.config.ts && echo "---" && cat tsconfig.json
grep -n -A 40 -i "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | head -70
grep -n -B4 -A 15 -i "viewTransition\|view transition" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md

node -e "const r=require('react'); console.log('react version:', r.version); console.log('ViewTransition:', typeof r.ViewTransition); console.log('unstable_ViewTransition:', typeof r.unstable_ViewTransition)" && echo "---types---" && grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -20

ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled/ | grep -i "^react" && echo "---" && for d in node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental; do echo "== $d"; node -e "try{const r=require('$d');console.log(r.version,'ViewTransition:',typeof r.ViewTransition, 'unstable:', typeof r.unstable_ViewTransition)}catch(e){console.log('ERR',e.message)}"; done

for d in react react-experimental; do echo "== $d"; node -e "const r=require('./node_modules/next/dist/compiled/$d');console.log(r.version,'| ViewTransition:',typeof r.ViewTransition,'| unstable_ViewTransition:',typeof r.unstable_ViewTransition)"; done

cat node_modules/@types/react/package.json | grep '"version"' && echo "--- next .d.ts refs ---" && grep -rln "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/ --include=*.d.ts | head -20 && echo "--- any ViewTransitionProps in types ---" && grep -rn "ViewTransitionProps\|ViewTransitionInstance" node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head
cat lib/products.ts && echo "---" && ls -a | head -30 && echo "--- next-env ---" && cat next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null || echo "no next-env.d.ts"

ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/ && echo "--- react-server exports ViewTransition? ---" && grep -c "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/react.react-server.js node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.react-server.development.js 2>/dev/null
grep -n "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.react-server.development.js
grep -o "ViewTransition=[a-zA-Z_$]*" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.react-server.production.js | head; echo "exit:$?"
grep -o "ViewTransition[^,;]\{0,30\}" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.react-server.production.js | head -5
grep -o "[^\"]\{0,120\}ViewTransition[^\"]\{0,160\}" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js | grep -i "warn\|must\|expect\|single\|child\|one " | head -20
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

(npx next dev --port 3111 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 12; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ -o /tmp/home.html -w "home:%{http_code}\n"; curl -s http://localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers -o /tmp/detail.html -w "detail:%{http_code}\n"; sleep 2; echo "=== dev log ==="; cat /tmp/dev.log | tail -25
git status --short && echo "=== AGENTS.md head ===" && head -20 AGENTS.md && echo "..." && wc -l AGENTS.md

echo "=== transitionTypes leaked to DOM? ===" ; grep -o "transitiontypes\|transitionTypes" /tmp/home.html | sort -u | head; echo "(none = good)"; echo; echo "=== grid card markup ==="; grep -o '<a[^>]*product-card[^>]*>.\{0,180\}' /tmp/home.html | head -2; echo; echo "=== detail hero markup ==="; grep -o '<main>.\{0,400\}' /tmp/detail.html | head -1

echo "=== where transitionTypes appears (context) ==="; grep -o '.\{60\}transitionTypes.\{60\}' /tmp/home.html | head -2; echo; echo "=== detail: product-hero + skeleton ==="; grep -o 'product-hero.\{0,160\}' /tmp/detail.html | head -2; echo "--- main tag ---"; grep -o '<main[^>]*>.\{0,120\}' /tmp/detail.html | head -2; echo "--- back-link ---"; grep -o '<a[^>]*back-link[^>]*>' /tmp/detail.html | head -2
grep -o '<main[^>]*>.\{0,90\}' /tmp/home.html | head -1; echo "--- all vt-name on home ---"; grep -o 'vt-name="[^"]*"' /tmp/home.html | sort | uniq -c

npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20; echo "tsc done"; sleep 3; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ -o /tmp/home2.html -w "home:%{http_code}\n"; echo "--- vt-name counts ---"; grep -o 'vt-name="[^"]*"' /tmp/home2.html | sort | uniq -c; echo "--- main tag ---"; grep -o '<main[^>]*>.\{0,80\}' /tmp/home2.html | head -1

tail -6 /tmp/dev.log; echo "=== css served? ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -o 'href="[^"]*\.css[^"]*"' | head -3; echo "=== browser available? ==="; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome node_modules/.bin/playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -i "playwright\|puppeteer" 2>/dev/null; echo "(end)"

curl -s http://localhost:3111/_next/static/chunks/app_globals_0yg4wg8.css -o /tmp/g.css; wc -c /tmp/g.css; echo "=== view-transition rules that survived compilation ==="; grep -o '::view-transition[a-z-]*([^)]*)' /tmp/g.css | sort | uniq -c; echo "=== keyframes ==="; grep -o '@keyframes [a-z-]*' /tmp/g.css | sort; echo "=== reduced motion block ==="; grep -o '@media (prefers-reduced-motion[^{]*{.\{0,300\}' /tmp/g.css
grep -n "pointer-events" /tmp/g.css; echo "exit=$?"; echo "--- all selectors in compiled css ---"; grep -o '^[^{]*{' /tmp/g.css | head -40
pkill -f "next dev" ; cat .gitignore; echo "--- final build ---"; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -18
cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "=== final build ==="; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -18
